# hg logs

**What this page tells you:** every `hg logs` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Container logs, crash context and argo conditions for one pod.

## Synopsis

```text
hg logs [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Flags

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--app` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one app's containers. |
| `--tail` | `<n>` | `50` | Lines per container. |
